title: Mount Athos dedicated to Mary and closed to women

tellings.quote: women to this day cannot go on Mount Athos, step foot on Mount Athos, because it's dedicated completely to Mary at the exclusion of all women.

plain: Mount Athos, a mountain in Greece that is home to monks, is said to be given over entirely to Mary, the mother of Jesus, and for that reason women still may not set foot on it to this day. A guest named Ralph Larson says so in passing, on an episode about a former CIA man who calls himself a time traveler.
